hints.text: When every value is the same, think about how far the data stretches from end to end.
The largest value is $5$ and the smallest value is also $5$. Subtract the smallest from the largest as usual.
$5 - 5 = 0$, so the range of this data is $0$.

explanation: The range is the largest value minus the smallest value.
Every value in the list is $5$, so the largest and the smallest are both $5$.
Subtract: $5 - 5 = 0$, so the range is $0$ because the data has no spread at all.
